if: the document is a receipt voucher referred to in clause (d) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 50 of the CGST Rules, 2017
the supply is in the course of inter-State trade or commerce
then: for an inter-State supply, the receipt voucher MUST carry the place of supply with the State name and State code
note: One mandatory particular of rule 50(i), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: place of supply along with the name of State and its code, in case of a supply in the course of inter-State trade or commerce;
